Cartier coefficient extraction partitions a 1x1 coefficient P_h=T_2h,h, two identical scalar Q_h=T_4h,2h, and the 3x3 block into a scalar and invariant 2x2 block. The integral coefficient recurrences for T_m,k and their second-order ODE, modulo p, prove determinant Δ=binom(6h,h)binom(6h,3h)(r²-4)^(2h) and scalar T_6h,5h=c_h(r²-4)^(2h)P_h; coefficients are units since indices<p. The 2x2 part is invertible on every smooth fiber. Semilinear stable rank then equals 2+2[P_h!=0]+2[Q_h!=0], in {2,4,6}. Independently verified determinant over every r in F17 and F41, and algebraic p17 factor P2/Q2; these finite tests support, not replace, the symbolic recurrences. No claims about other primes or Newton polygons.
